# Dither Icons

> 73 original SVG icons with fine ordered dither and individually authored semantic motion. React 18+, MIT.

## Start here

- [Complete integration guide](/llms-full.txt): API, examples, behavior and valid exports.
- [Agent contract](/AI.md): concise instructions for integrating the library.
- [Icon manifest](/icons.json): schema version 1; exact names, exports, keywords and motion metadata.

## Documentation

- [Using Dither Icons](/docs/introduction.md): Install an icon, choose a material, and configure playback.
- [Install Dither Icons](/docs/installation.md): Use the React package or download individual SVGs from the catalog.
- [React API](/docs/react.md): Component imports, SVG props, and playback controls.
- [Animation controls](/docs/motion.md): Configure triggers, inspect frames, and handle reduced motion.
- [Accessibility](/docs/accessibility.md): Label controls, support keyboard input, and respect reduced-motion preferences.
- [Export SVGs](/docs/svg.md): Download icons with your selected material, color, size, and motion setting.

## Visual references

- [Material comparison](/reference/textures.svg)
- [All icons with export names](/reference/icons.svg)

## Installation status

Version 0.2.1. Install with `npm install @unlocalhosted/dither-icons`.
